# Termux-Vision Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine for Android Termux.
Provides pure Python/JS 5-stage Canny Edge Detector, Sobel 3x3, Gaussian Blur, 2D Integral Images, Haar Cascade Face Detection, and on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference with Vulkan GPU acceleration and automatic CPU fallback under 500MB RAM.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-vision
- npm: termux-vision
- Command: pip install termux-vision
- npm Command: npm install -g termux-vision
- One-Touch Installer: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
- Documentation: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/vision/
